info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v3-spec
info.description: This API retrieves detailed information about mortgage loan payoffs, providing users with essential insights into loan balances and potential savings. It allows financial institutions and servicing agencies to assess loan statuses and manage repayments effectively. Typical consumers include mortgage analysts, loan officers, and financial advisors who require access to real-time payoff information. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can enhance decision-making processes and improve customer service related to mortgage loan management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the details regarding the payoff of a specific loan, including the remaining balance and any associated fees. Use this information to assist in loan management and planning.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the loan payoff details. It contains essential parameters needed to process the request and return the corresponding loan payoff information.

201.description: The payoff request was successfully processed and the details are returned.
